title: 1 PLAYER ARCADE DEMO
why: His order of 2026-10-11 evening: arcade mode also needs a single player option. The title now has a 1 PLAYER ARCADE DEMO row next to the 2 player one. It starts the arcade in this one window, with no player 2 window and no pairing. It plays exactly like the 2 player arcade: endless, the spawn shield, the random loadout, the extraction bonus and re-drop, waves, streaks, idle return, the attract loop, the controls card and the Halloween dressing. The score at the top says SCORE instead of TEAM SCORE, with no YOU and P2 split, and the run over card shows one row. Solo runs go on their own list on the party board, so a solo score is never ranked against two player team scores. The 2 player arcade and normal raids are unchanged.
now: The title has a 1 PLAYER ARCADE DEMO row: the arcade party mode for one player in one window, with its own scoreboard.
